en.headline: URA advises against hiring Taizoom for lift subsidy scheme
en.dek: The Urban Renewal Authority said it has lost confidence in the contractor after inspections found missing fire-safety components in lifts at hundreds of buildings.
body: The Urban Renewal Authority has advised property owners participating in its lift modernisation subsidy scheme not to hire Taizoom Elevator, stating that it has lost confidence in the company following findings of missing fire-resistant door frame components.

A spokesman told the South China Morning Post that the advice followed serious failures identified when Taizoom replaced lifts at multiple housing estates and buildings. The government had earlier suspended the company’s performance rating after citywide checks confirmed the components were absent in 338 buildings.

Industry representatives have called for more frequent inspections and assistance for buildings that already signed contracts with the firm and are awaiting work. The Electrical and Mechanical Services Department has said the missing parts do not affect the safe operation of the lifts but has ordered remedial work at the contractor’s expense.

zh.headline: 市建局建議補貼計劃業主避免聘用臺日電梯
zh.dek: 市建局表示，因檢查發現數百幢大廈升降機欠缺防火組件，已對承辦商失去信心。
body: 市區重建局建議參與升降機現代化補貼計劃的業主，避免聘用臺日電梯公司，指在發現多幢樓宇升降機欠缺防火門框組件後，已對該公司失去信心。
發言人向《南華早報》表示，有關建議源於臺日電梯在多個屋邨及樓宇更換升降機時出現嚴重缺失。政府早前已暫停該公司的表現評級，全市檢查確認338幢樓宇欠缺相關組件。
業界人士呼籲加強日常檢查，並協助已與該公司簽約、正等待開工的樓宇管理處。機電工程署表示，欠缺組件不影響升降機安全運作，但已下令承辦商自費進行補救工程。
